column1: # GeoNames NG admin-name -> geo_places code overrides (SPEC-W68 WS2).
# Consulted FIRST at both levels by geonames_ng_localities.py
# default slug(asciiname) join against the seeded gazetteer codes.
# geonames_key: the GeoNames admin key ("NG.11" / "NG.11.01") OR the
#               (ascii)name exactly as it appears in admin1CodesASCII.txt /
# geo_places_code: the seeded code from services/geo-service/seeds/
# GeoNames spells the FCT "Federal Capital Territory"; the seed uses "FCT".
# GeoNames spells the state "Nassarawa"; the seed uses "Nasarawa".
